$comment: Google Sheets data sources. Map a tab name to its PUBLISHED-to-the-web CSV URL (File → Share → Publish to web → select the tab → CSV). Example: "tabs": { "team": { "url": "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-.../pub?gid=0&single=true&output=csv" } }. scripts/fetch-sheets.mjs snapshots each tab to src/data/sheets/<name>.json at build time; the worker serves the same tabs live at /api/data/<name>. This lives in JSON, not site.ts, because plain Node scripts cannot import TypeScript, and both fetch-sheets.mjs and worker/index.ts read THIS file directly — there is no re-export in site.ts to keep in step. PRIVACY: only publish a public tab that QUERY-selects the public columns of approved rows; the master tab with emails/phones stays unpublished.
